meta.title: Rihlati — Travel agency offers in Algeria
meta.description: Compare Omra, Hajj, organized trips and visa services from verified Algerian travel agencies.

common.tagline: Every Algerian travel agency offer, in one place

search.emptyHint: Try widening the search — fewer filters, or another period.

offer.seatsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
offer.priceNote: per person, depending on the package
offer.reviews: {count, plural, =0 {No reviews yet} one {# review} other {# reviews}}
offer.whatsappText: Hello, I'm contacting you from Rihlati about the offer: {title}

inquiry.title: Ask for more information
inquiry.subtitle: The agency calls you back — free, no commitment.
inquiry.name: Your name
inquiry.phoneHint: 05/06/07… — the agency will contact you on this number
inquiry.consent: I agree to be contacted by the agency about this offer
inquiry.successBody: {agency} received your request and will contact you shortly.
inquiry.errConsent: Tick the box so the agency may contact you
inquiry.errGeneric: Sending failed. Check your connection and try again.

footer.note: Rihlati connects travelers with verified agencies. Offers are published by the agencies.
footer.reportHint: Problem with an offer? Report it from its page.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.subtitle: One account, whether you book a trip or run an agency.
signup.emailHint: Phone or email — at least one of the two.
signup.errEmailTaken: An account already exists with this email. Sign in instead.
signup.errPhoneTaken: An account already exists with this number. Sign in instead.
signup.errIdentifierRequired: Enter a phone number or an email.
signup.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
signup.errGeneric: Could not create the account. Try again.

console.loginSubtitle: Sign in to manage your offers and clients.
console.errInvalid: Invalid credentials. Check and try again.
console.noAgencyBody: This account is not attached to any agency. Create yours in a few minutes: you fill it in, then Rihlati checks your documents before travelers can see it.
console.inboxEmpty: No contacts yet. Requests from the site will appear here.
console.notesEmpty: No notes. What you write here stays inside your agency.
console.notePlaceholder: Called on the 12th, wants a double room…
console.statsLockedBody: Your data has been collected since day one: the day you upgrade, the full history is waiting.
console.faqIntro: Answer your recurring questions once. They appear on your public page.
console.question: Question
console.errUnverified: Google did not confirm your email address. Sign in with a password.
console.errFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.

manifest.tripLinkMessage: Hello {name}, here is your trip programme, with the meeting points: {url}
manifest.title: Your departures
manifest.empty: No planned departures. Any offer with a departure date appears here automatically.
manifest.reservedNoSeats: {people, plural, one {# person reserved} other {# people reserved}}
manifest.name: Name
manifest.emptyManifest: Nobody on the list yet. Add confirmed clients below.

links.title: Your tracked links
links.intro: Create one link per post, paste it under your Facebook or Instagram post, and see how many clients it actually brought you.
links.label: Link name
links.empty: No links yet. Create one below.
links.limitReached: Plan limit reached. Delete a link or upgrade.

offerForm.title: Your offers
offerForm.empty: No offers yet. Create the first one below.
offerForm.quotaFull: Publishing limit reached for your plan. Pause an offer or upgrade.
offerForm.photoHint: Paste an image link. File upload is coming soon.
offerForm.reviewNote: Rihlati reviews your offer before publishing. That is what protects travelers' trust.
offerForm.duplicateWarning: This offer looks very similar to another of yours. Did you mean to edit the original? It stays visible but ranks lower in results.
offerForm.attributesHint: These fields are optional. Filling them in helps travelers compare your offer against other agencies'.

programme.title: Itinerary
programme.intro: The trip's steps, in order. Steps marked as checkpoints let you check off which families are present.
programme.empty: No steps yet. Add the first one below.
programme.titleHint: Short and readable: this title is what shows on the traveler's map. Details belong in the description.
programme.checkpointMandatoryHint: Mandatory: every family must be checked in fresh here, no exceptions.
programme.checkpointOptionalHint: Optional: a family absent here defaults to absent at the next optional step, until you check them in again.
programme.emptyAttendance: No active reservations on this departure.
programme.dragHint: Drag a step to move it, or use the arrows.
programme.duplicateDayHint: Copies every step of one day onto another. No other day moves.
programme.copyFromOfferHint: Takes the whole programme of one of your offers, days and order included. It is added to the end of this one.
programme.copyFromOfferAction: {count, plural, one {Add # step} other {Add the # steps}}
programme.limitReached: This programme has reached its step limit. Delete some before copying more.

trip.tripOver: Your trip is complete. Safe journey home!
trip.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
trip.invalidBody: Contact your agency to get a new link to your trip.

programmeMap.tapHint: Tap a step to see the details.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Your profile, your picture and the interface language.
account.photoSubtitle: Shown next to your name in the agency console.
account.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. 5 MB maximum.
account.identifierHint: To change your email or phone, contact support — these are what you sign in with.
account.agencyNone: You are not attached to any agency.
account.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.

agencyForm.createSubtitle: Fill in your agency, then request verification.
agencyForm.reviewNotice: Your agency starts as a draft. Someone at Rihlati checks your commercial register and tourism licence by hand before travelers can see it — that manual step is what makes the “verified” badge mean anything.
agencyForm.sectionIdentityHelp: The name travelers will see, and your public address.
agencyForm.name: Agency name
agencyForm.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Cannot be changed later: shared links would stop working.
agencyForm.legalNameHint: The official name on your commercial register, if different.
agencyForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Agency specialising in Omra and Hajj since 2010, departures from Algiers…
agencyForm.descriptionHint: Travelers read this before contacting you. Search uses it too.
agencyForm.sectionContactHelp: How travelers reach you. WhatsApp is by far the most used.
agencyForm.whatsappHint: Often the same number as the phone.
agencyForm.sectionLocationHelp: Wilaya is a search filter: without it you do not appear in filtered results.
agencyForm.sectionLegalHelp: Checked by hand at Rihlati. Never shown to travelers.
agencyForm.tourismLicenceHint: Licence number issued by the Ministry of Tourism.
agencyForm.logoSubtitle: Shown on your public page and next to each of your offers.
agencyForm.verifyBody: Someone at Rihlati checks your documents. Until then your offers stay invisible to travelers.
agencyForm.errSlugTaken: That public address is taken. Try another.
agencyForm.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
agencyForm.errRole: Your role does not allow this change.

admin.title: Verification queue
admin.subtitle: Agencies waiting on a decision. Read the documents, ring the number, then decide.
admin.checkedNoteHelp: Internal. This is the answer to “what exactly did you verify?” on the day someone asks.
admin.checkedNotePlaceholder: Read the RC and the licence, address matches the wilaya, phone answered.
admin.reasonHelp: The agency reads this word for word in their console. Write it as if you were saying it to them.
admin.reasonPlaceholder: The licence provided has expired. Send the renewal.
admin.internalNoteHelp: Never shown to the agency. For what you cannot put in the reason.
admin.notAdminTitle: This page is not for you
admin.errAlreadyDecided: This agency has already been handled — reload the page.
admin.errSelfReview: You cannot decide the fate of your own agency.
admin.errValidation: Check the fields you filled in.

validation.amountNotInteger: The amount must be a whole number of centimes
validation.checkedNoteTooShort: Describe in one sentence what was checked
validation.clientConsentRequired: Confirm that the client agreed to be contacted
validation.clientOrContactRequired: Give an existing client, or a name and a phone number
validation.consentRequired: You must agree to be contacted by the agency
validation.departureRequired: Say which departure this is for
validation.durationMinAboveMax: The minimum duration is longer than the maximum
validation.emailOrPhoneRequired: An email address or a phone number is required
validation.imageFormatUnsupported: Unsupported format. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
validation.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters
validation.priceMaxBelowMin: The maximum price must be above the minimum price
validation.priceMinAboveMax: The minimum price must be below the maximum price
validation.rejectionReasonTooShort: Explain the rejection in a sentence — the agency reads it verbatim
validation.returnBeforeDeparture: The return date must come after the departure date
validation.slugFormat: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only
validation.startAfterEnd: The start date must come before the end date
